about: A 72-year-old is supplied Zoloft (sertraline, an SSRI) every month from March 2026 together with Plavix (clopidogrel, an antiplatelet) and Eliquis (apixaban, an anticoagulant), all by brand name only.
At age 69, the patient has supplies of venlafaxine and clopidogrel alongside Aspro Clear Extra Strength for pain, which counts once in the NSAID group even with pantoprazole supplied.
The record shows sertraline with aspirin for clot prevention in a 74-year-old, so aspirin counts once and only the antiplatelet group is present.
